Ignacio "Nacho" Varga is a Mexican-American career criminal from Albuquerque, New Mexico, and the son of Manuel Varga, the manager of A-Z Fine Upholstery. Nacho was formerly an employee at his father's shop A-Z Fine Upholstery before becoming affiliated with the Cartel. He became one of Tuco Salamanca's most trusted enforcers and later became the lieutenant of both Hector and Lalo Salamanca. Against his will, Nacho later became an informant to Gustavo Fring after being blackmailed by him. As his role in both the Cartel and Gus' drug operation began to amplify, Nacho became increasingly discouraged with the organizations as his affiliation with them put both his and his father's lives in danger.
Nacho will get the job done. He won’t like it, but he will do it. He cares deeply about his dad. He has a stony, cold exterior that’s almost impenetrable. He is loyal to his boss and the cartel, though he doesn’t necessarily like them. Was shown to be a highly intelligent, quiet, and somewhat reserved career criminal with dubious loyalty to the Cartel. He was a capable criminal and leader, acting as a lieutenant to Tuco and Lalo Salamanca. He is single and is not reluctant to have a relationship. Nacho will get the job done. He is loyal to his boss and the cartel, though he doesn’t necessarily like them. Nacho Varga was shown to be a highly intelligent, quiet, and somewhat reserved career criminal with dubious loyalty to the Cartel. Nacho was a capable criminal and leader, acting as a lieutenant to Tuco, Hector and Lalo Salamanca. Nacho shows qualities of a good leader as well. He was able to conduct business with the Cartel and perform his own side jobs without the Cartel ever knowing. Despite Nacho's dangerous lifestyle, he does show compassion for some people in his life, especially his father, which he did everything in his power to protect. He also shows compassion for unfortunate civilians that were caught in the Cartel's schemes.
